# Gallery

<!-- Generated by tools/gallery.mjs; edit that, not this file. -->

This page is heavy: 49 animated SVGs.

Every field preset, reveal preset, bundled tagline font and glyph set, plus three colour samples, rendered small. Rebuild with `npm run gallery`. Sizes are raw bytes of these small SVGs; [fields.md](../fields.md) and [reveals.md](../reveals.md) give full-size (880 × 240, 20 s) figures.

## Glyph sets

`field.ramp` given as a glyph set name (see [fields.md](../fields.md#the-field-block)). 440 × 120, field loop 6 s at 6 fps, waves field; scramble reveal, whose noise draws from the same set; tagline "ascii banner" in `ansi-shadow`. The sets beyond ASCII cost 3 bytes a glyph, so they take `field.bands: 1`.

## Colours

The field's and the taglines' own hues instead of the one `accent` (see [fields.md](../fields.md#colours) and [reveals.md](../reveals.md#config)). 440 × 120, field loop 6 s at 6 fps, waves field, scramble reveal; tagline "ascii banner" in `ansi-shadow`. Every hue reads on white and on GitHub dark (#0d1117).
